turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:

"I see an ant on the wall." Step 1: the next word is ant. Step 2: its first sound is "a", a vowel sound. Step 3: so I write an.
Rule: use an before a vowel sound and a before other sounds.
Right: He has a bike. Wrong: He has an bike.

Now it is your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
